columns_never_fillable.reason: EMA model — under the Entrusted Management Agreement, Group receives EMA rental income (fixed + variable) and the Entrusted Manager bears ALL property operating expenses. There is no property-opex line in the audited Statement of Total Return, so a conventional per-property NPI is not disclosed. Per-property EMA rental income IS disclosed (RMB) on the cards and kept in properties[]._ema_rental_income_rmb_million.

Per-property revenue is disclosed only as EMA rental income in RMB million (kept in _ema_rental_income_rmb_million); no SGD per-property gross revenue figure is given. Per-property outlet sales (RMB) and EMA rental income (RMB) are operational metrics, not SGD audited gross revenue.
Cards disclose Gross Floor Area (GFA) and Net Lettable Area (NLA), not a separate 'gross lettable area' (GLA). GFA -> gfa, NLA -> nla; gla left null to avoid coercion.
